ledger.pool_shortfall_reason: Configured shared 289-ID hybrid pool cannot retain 32 x 32768 prefixes: >=256 full-attention +96 linear checkpoint +1 null IDs =353 before additional live reservations. Current dense pool layout adds 4744806400 bytes/device for64 more IDs, exceeding post-preparation free4731160064 bytes before runtime scratch. This is a configured-pool/layout bound, not proof of a hard physical model limit; target32768 traffic not yet measured.
